| Pros | Cons |
|------|------|
| **Increased flexibility** – Employees can often set their own schedules and more easily manage personal and family responsibilities. | **Social isolation** – Reduced face-to-face interaction with colleagues can lead to feelings of loneliness and disconnection from the team. |
| **No commute** – Eliminating daily travel saves time and money while lowering stress and reducing carbon emissions. | **Communication challenges** – Reliance on digital tools can lead to misinterpretations, delayed responses, and reduced spontaneous collaboration. |
| **Cost savings** – Workers typically spend less on transportation, professional attire, and meals, while employers may save on office space. | **Work-life boundary blur** – When the home is also the office, it can be harder to "switch off," increasing the risk of overworking and burnout. |
